title: AskGLP1: A Knowledge Graph LLM Agent for Exploring GLP-1 Experience from Online Patient Narratives
abstract: arXiv:2610.34987v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: GLP-1 medications are increasingly used for weight management, and many people share their experiences online. These narratives show why people take the drugs and what they experience, but they remain unstructured and disconnected from formal pharmacovigilance. We therefore present AskGLP1, a system that transforms online patient narratives into a knowledge graph (KG) and answers questions about medication experiences. Through an LLM-assisted pipeline grounded in the MedDRA terminology, AskGLP1 screens nearly 8.5 million Reddit posts for medication experiences and distills 163,135 of them, with 2,506 WebMD reviews, into a KG of 385,790 drug-side-effect and drug-purpose relations. We find that GLP-1 experiences are source- and drug-specific. translated_title: AskGLP1：一个用于从在线患者叙述中探索GLP-1用药经验的知识图谱LLM智能体
translated_abstract: GLP-1药物越来越多地被用于体重管理，许多人在网上分享他们的用药体验。这些叙述展示了人们为何服用这些药物以及他们的感受，但这些内容仍是非结构化的，且与正式的药物警戒体系相脱节。因此，我们提出了AskGLP1，一个将在线患者叙述转化为知识图谱（KG）并回答用药经验相关问题的系统。通过一个基于MedDRA术语的LLM辅助流程，AskGLP1从近850万条Reddit帖子中筛选用药经验，提炼出163,135条经验，并与2,506条WebMD评论一起，构建了一个包含385,790条药物-副作用和药物-用途关系的知识图谱。我们发现GLP-1用药经验具有来源特异性和药物特异性。在线叙述与FAERS共享最常见的胃肠道症状，但在线叙述更突出诸如疲劳和食物厌恶等日常负担，而FAERS报告则更多涉及注射相关事件
tldr: 提出AskGLP1系统，利用LLM辅助流程将近850万条在线患者叙述构建成基于MedDRA术语的知识图谱，揭示GLP-1用药经验具有来源和药物特异性，且在线叙述更关注疲劳等日常负担，而FAERS报告更多涉及注射相关事件
en_tdlr: AskGLP1 transforms millions of online patient narratives into a MedDRA-grounded knowledge graph via an LLM-assisted pipeline, revealing that GLP-1 experiences are source- and drug-specific, with online narratives highlighting everyday burdens like fatigue while FAERS reports more often include injection-related events.
